identity.description: Find evidence in approved presentations and build a traceable, editable PowerPoint briefing.

model.tenantSelection: Select an available model approved for the Power Platform environment. Test actual retrieval and costs under the pilot licence.

hooks.action: Validate each candidate ID, source page and reporting date before using it in a plan.
Refresh the plan, revise using expected_revision, and collect new confirmation for the revised selection.
Require explicit confirmation of the exact plan and its current revision.
Inspect the source map, output URL, warnings and GetLayoutReport before delivery.

memory.ownership: Isolate conversation variables by requester. Reauthorize stored plans and output access in the service.

monitor.agent: Record a test trace and outcome under the approved tenant retention policy.
monitor.backend: Record request IDs, stage, job status and error category. Verify that test permissions exclude another user’s files.

channels.pilot: Publish in Dev/Test, enable the Teams channel and share with an approved test group.

implementationGaps: Connector support for local-only reconstruction, translated notes and multi-version QA downloads requires explicit tenant implementation.
Use the deployed backend identity and SharePoint grants in the tenant acceptance run.
